intro: Nee Sannidhi Chalu is the latest Telugu Christian worship song written, tuned & composed by Evangelist Sam Prasad, translation & sung by Abhi Joy & music composed by Immanuel Jacob. The official music video was released on July 15, 2025, through his official YouTube channel, Abhi Joy, inviting hearts into a deeper worship experience.
